title: Discord and Facebook Fetchers
description: Begins with an everyday explanation, then traces DiscordFetcher in src/fetchers/discord_fetcher.py. Source units combined: Discord Fetcher and Facebook Fetcher, Instagram Fetcher and Medium Fetcher.

learning_objectives.text: Explain discord and facebook fetchers in plain language using the project source.
Trace `DiscordFetcher` in `src/fetchers/discord_fetcher.py` and explain its inputs, behavior, and output.
Use a test or boundary case to assess what the implementation proves and what remains unverified.
